show.description: Country’s most celebrated defense scientist is beaten, humiliated, and nearly erased by a billionaire’s untouchable daughter after a roadside clash spirals into violence. But when the assault video goes viral, buried truths explode into public view. Now, one arrogant empire faces the terrifying reality that the man they destroyed may be the one holding their future in his hands.
